I’ll read the claim, cleanup, and migration bodies next, and check the snapshot diffs for anything outside the approved shape changes.**GREEN. No actionable findings.**

The staged P08.5 diff keeps I1–I6. Signup claim still takes the advisory transaction lock before row locks, replays all four binding columns under `FOR UPDATE`, and writes only with the pending, not-deleted, `signup_key IS NULL` predicate. Cleanup still commits `pool_cleanup` before `DROP DATABASE`, and deletes and decrements only when that marker is still present. The signup and cleanup columns stay out of `Account` mass assignment. The physical catalogue matches the approved renames, the ten integer-to-bigint counters and their default casts, and the D114 column replacement.

Material residual limits:

- This is a fresh version-1 baseline. Historical migration names are gone, and there is no installed-schema upgrade path.
- The tenant PostgreSQL Golden harness still stages the core baseline and this tenancy baseline before the remaining historical pending cohort. Whole-cohort order stays with the later items.
